ITEM 1 | Two pale yellow-green, translucent, glossy oval pieces about 2 cm long, one at upper right and one at lower center of the plate; smooth, slightly waxy sheen, firm and holding shape, with no cooking marks, resting directly on the white plate | 7
ITEM 2 | About 13 bright red to orange-red translucent glossy oval pieces, each roughly 2 to 2.5 cm long and 1.8 cm wide, with a smooth, slightly wet sheen, some with lighter amber edges; firm and holding shape, scattered loosely across the plate in a curved arrangement, with no browning or char | 45
ITEM 3 | About 8 dark maroon to brown translucent glossy oval pieces, roughly 2 cm long, with a smooth, moist sheen and deeper color at the centers; firm, holding shape, mixed among the red pieces on the plate, with no cooking marks | 28
